name: Paper Pop
summary: A trip planner welcome built like a pop-up book: paper scenes fold flat and spring up as you swipe
about: A four-page onboarding for a travel planner where every page is a pop-up book scene made of cut paper layers: snowy peaks over a lake, a jeep on a mountain road, a cabin with chimney smoke, and tents under the stars. Drag sideways and the current layers fold down flat one after another while the next scene springs up with a little overshoot, and a stretchy inchworm tracks the page. The last button grows into Start planning, which closes the book, draws a check and throws paper confetti.
how: Drag or swipe the scene left or right; past the halfway mark (or with a quick flick) the page turns, otherwise it springs back.
Use the round Next button, tap a dot, press Skip, or use the Left and Right arrow keys when the pager has focus.
Watch the layers fold at different speeds, the sky change and the inchworm stretch between the dots.
On the last page press Start planning: the book closes, Trip board ready appears with confetti, then it opens again at page one.
